source_assertion: The 2016 study retains a wild-type dual-cofactor comparator and engineered mutants. Its TEV construct is expected to retain Gly-His. These are preparation-specific observations, not exact equality to the current native sequence.
S1 Table identifies Escherichia coli P0AC53 among sequences analyzed. This is an accession bridge for sequence analysis, not a complete kinetic construct sequence proof.

KEGG supplies the beta-specific reaction convention. Applying the enzyme activity to this exact anomer-specific source equation is a qualified annotation-level inference, not direct exclusive-anomer characterization.

The K-12 pgl/ybhE product is annotated with Rhea12556 hydrolysis using ECO:0000269/PMID15576773; the current native sequence is 331 residues.
Mutations made in DY378 were moved to MG1655. Loss of pgl removed extract lactonase activity, and plasmid complementation restored it; the assay was explicitly not fully quantitative.

The K-12 edd/b1851 entry annotates Rhea17277 activity with HAMAP and experimental citations. Its current 603-residue sequence has PLR at 252–254, versus historical AC; exact old construct equality is not established.
The edd ORF was amplified from K-12 DNA and expressed in BL21(DE3); active lysates were used. Mn supplementation during expression is not proof of an obligatory bound Mn cofactor.
The native KHG/KDPG aldolase complex catalyzes KDPGALDOL-RXN via KDPGALDOL-ENZRXN. The same source also describes additional reactions outside this exact module.
The current Eda entry annotates KDPG cleavage to D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate and pyruvate with experimental evidence and identifies a homotrimer.
KDPG cleavage was assayed through pyruvate production using coupled lactate dehydrogenase. NADH consumption belongs to that reporter and is not part of the aldolase equation.
The native complex contains three copies of KDPGALDOL-4OH2OXOGLUTARALDOL-MONOMER.
The component object explicitly unifies UniProt P0A955; the curated native species is K-12 MG1655.
The current K-12 entry states Homotrimer with experimental evidence including PMID11274385.

The recombinant E. coli enzyme has trimeric subunit assembly. The eda/pKK-223 preparation is described; expression-host and SeMet preparation details do not independently establish a MG1655 donor strain.

The entry assigns one [4Fe-4S] cluster using ECO:0000250, ECO:0000255 and curator inference ECO:0000305. The one-cluster note is similarity/HAMAP evidence, not direct Edd cluster stoichiometry measurement.
Edd lysate activity was peroxide-sensitive and recoverable with iron/DTT. The explicit [3Fe-4S] EPR signal in this passage belongs to fumarase A; it is not an Edd spectrum.
The entry assigns cytoplasm as cellular location with ECO:0000305 curator inference.
The native definition orders oxidation, lactone hydrolysis, dehydration and aldol cleavage, with both oxidation alternatives in the same first position.
